hooks.command: ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; [ -d "$ROOT/.git" ] || exit 0; cd "$ROOT" || exit 0; if find . -mindepth 2 -type d -name .git -not -path './.git/*' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then exit 0; fi; ( git add -u && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -q -m "auto-backup $(date +%F)") && git push -q origin main ) >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 0

command -v gbrain >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ( gbrain sync --source brain --no-embed >/dev/null 2>&1 & GB=$!; ( n=0; while [ $n -lt 90 ]; do sleep 1; kill -0 $GB 2>/dev/null || exit 0; n=$((n+1)); done; kill -TERM $GB 2>/dev/null; sleep 5; kill -KILL $GB 2>/dev/null ) & WD=$!; wait $GB 2>/dev/null; kill $WD 2>/dev/null; wait $WD 2>/dev/null ) >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
